question: Which zip code has the most property listings, and how many does it have?
sparql:
SELECT ?zipCodeName (COUNT(?listing) AS ?listingCount)

FROM <https://omnix.dev/graphs/demo-tenant/kg/zillow-austin>
WHERE {
  ?listing <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://omnix.dev/types/PropertyListing> .
  ?listing <https://omnix.dev/onto/zipcode> ?zipCode .
  ?zipCode <https://omnix.dev/types/ZipCode/attrs/name> ?zipCodeName .
}
GROUP BY ?zipCodeName
ORDER BY DESC(?listingCount)
LIMIT 1

question: For each Publisher Type, what is the count of games released in the Modern Console era (2001-2010), and which type has the most?
sparql:
SELECT ?publisher_type (COUNT(?game) AS ?game_count)

FROM <https://omnix.dev/graphs/demo-tenant/kg/video-games>
WHERE {
  ?game <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://omnix.dev/types/VideoGame> .
  ?game <https://omnix.dev/types/VideoGame/attrs/release_year> ?release_year .
  FILTER (?release_year >= 2001 && ?release_year <= 2010).
  ?game <https://omnix.dev/types/VideoGame/attrs/publisher_type> ?publisher_type .
}
GROUP BY ?publisher_type
ORDER BY DESC(?game_count)
LIMIT 1
